The competitor's launch of a mobile-integrated loyalty program offering discounts, rewards, and personalization poses a significant threat to our business. By enhancing customer retention through seamless digital engagement and personalized incentives, they are likely to increase customer stickiness and reduce churn. This strategy could directly erode our market share by attracting our existing customers who value convenience and tailored experiences. To mitigate this impact, we should consider accelerating our own digital transformation efforts, enhancing our loyalty offerings, and focusing on unique value propositions that differentiate us from the competitor's approach.
